//: Ratchets for packages/tooling/src/token-checks/token-references.ts (TASK-R5-O7).
Both move in ONE direction only. Raising either to make a run pass is the
failure mode the ratchet exists to prevent — lower the number or fix the code.
maxUnusedTokens — tokens tokens.css emits that NO source or doc anywhere in
the repo references. Measured at 271 of 674 on 2026-09-15 at 99b963a.
• 164 are palette shades (--dz-colors-<ramp>-<shade>). A design system
legitimately ships complete ramps, so these are not debt and the ceiling
is not expected to reach zero.
• 107 are component-tier tokens — whole emitted sets for --dz-badge-*,
--dz-dialog-*, --dz-card-*, --dz-chart-2..10 — that no component reads,
because those components style themselves with Tailwind utilities
instead. That half IS debt, and it is the half this ceiling is aimed at.
Exit condition: the component-tier half reaches 0, either by wiring the
components to their own tokens or by not emitting tokens nothing honours.
272 since 2026-10-02 (merge of the architecture programme): the palette half is
165, the component-tier half is still 107. --dz-colors-orange-600 had exactly one
reference in the repository -- DzImageCard's Product Grid story painting it as
raw text, 2.34:1 on the dark surface -- and when that rule-1b defect was fixed
the shade joined the rest of its ramp in the unused set. The count had been
crediting a palette shade as used on the strength of a contrast defect; the
half this ceiling is aimed at did not move. A future split of the two halves
into separate numbers would stop a palette shade from ever reading as debt.
maxAliasCycles — an alias ring (--dz-a: var(--dz-b); --dz-b: var(--dz-a))
makes every name on it resolve to nothing. There is no acceptable count
above zero, so this ceiling is a constant, not a ratchet.
